name: Lucidchart
description: Lucidchart is an intelligent diagramming platform for creating diagrams with AI, data, and automation to visualize and optimize systems, processes, and organizational structures.
best_for: Positioned for enterprise teams across IT, engineering, product, project management, and operations who need to document and optimize processes, infrastructure, and technical systems.
features: Lucid AI generates diagrams from text prompts
Data linking to Google Sheets, Excel, or CSV files
Conditional formatting to highlight patterns in data
Template library for processes, org charts, and technical diagrams
100+ integrations including Jira, Confluence, Slack, and Microsoft Teams

alternatives.name: Miro
alternatives.description: A visual collaboration platform with an infinite multiplayer canvas for research, planning, and product development.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting open-ended whiteboarding alongside structured diagrams

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A browser- and desktop-based design tool for interface design, prototyping, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need diagramming alongside actual UI design work

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 3 editable Lucidchart documents and 60 shapes per document.

tiers.name: Individual
tiers.notes: Unlimited documents and shapes; price shown on Lucidchart trial page.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Paid team plan; exact price depends on checkout/configuration.

cons: The Free plan is limited to 3 editable Lucidchart documents and 60 shapes per document.
Enterprise pricing is not self-serve on the public plan overview and requires contacting sales.
